home.heroHint: An open archive of ideas worth keeping
home.emptyBody: Once you publish your first article, it will appear on this quiet homepage.

studio.title: All documents
studio.emptyBody: Draft a note, an essay, or a research thread. Your workspace will grow around the way you think.
studio.deleteFolderBody: Delete “{name}”? Items inside will move to the parent folder.
studio.mediaEmptyBody: Upload an image, audio, video, or document and it will appear here.

login.title: Sign in to your core.
login.body: Your workspace is waiting exactly where you left it.
login.footnote: Authentication is wired through the Knowledge-Core Gateway.

register.title: Start your core.
register.body: A focused space for writing, learning, and sharing.

auth.verifyHint: Verify your email before signing in.
auth.accepted: Request accepted. Check your email to continue.
auth.resetLinkRequired: Open the reset link from your email, or request a new one.
auth.emailConflict: This email is already registered. Sign in, or request a new verification link if you have not verified yet.
auth.usernameConflict: This username is already taken. Choose another username.
auth.emailNotVerified: Verify your email before signing in. Open the link from your inbox, or request a new one.
auth.verifyExpired: This verification link has expired. Enter your email to request a new one.
auth.verifyUsed: This email is already verified. You can sign in.
auth.verifyInvalid: This verification link is invalid. Enter your email to request a new one.
auth.resetExpired: This reset link has expired. Request a new password reset email.
auth.resetUsed: This reset link has already been used. Sign in or request a new reset email.
auth.resetInvalid: This reset link is invalid. Request a new password reset email.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email.
verifyEmail.bodyWithToken: We are confirming the link from your Knowledge Core email.
verifyEmail.bodyWithoutToken: Open the link in your Knowledge Core email, or enter your address to request a new one.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password.
forgotPassword.body: We will send a one-time link if the account exists.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password.
resetPassword.bodyWithToken: Choose a new password to finish recovering your account.
resetPassword.bodyWithoutToken: Open the one-time link from your recovery email to continue.
